properties.note: Half (1) is fixed: add_artifact takes `checksum` and stores it as the first baseline, refusing to move one that exists. Half (2), delete_edge refusing endpoint types, stands as built on the record's own judgement that the refusal is defensible; the friction it names — a rejected field not saying whether it moved or was never there — is the open wish dec:idea-a-rejected-field-says-whether-it-moved-or-was-never-there, not this record.
